name: @projexlight/sdk-handoff
summary: Sales→Delivery handoff SDK (P15·E2). Manages one handoff record per closed-won deal being transitioned to onboarding/CS, carrying CS owner/backup personas, prework, promises, risks, integrations and milestones. Drives a validated status lifecycle (draft -> pending -> accepted/rejected -> completed, cancellable from any non-terminal state); every transition stamps its timestamp and emits a lifecycle event through sdk-audit. A durable kickoff→prework→promises→risks→milestones saga is driven by sdk-workflow (with per-phase compensation projected into handoff.saga_step), and the CS accept/reject gate is delegated to sdk-approval by loose id. All data is tenant-scoped and persona-keyed.

endpoints.description: Create a handoff in status 'draft' for a closed-won deal; requires tenant_id and from_persona_id and emits handoff.created.v1.
List tenant-scoped handoffs (tenant_id query param required), optionally filtered by status and deal_id with limit/offset paging.
Fetch a single tenant-scoped handoff record by id; 404 when it does not exist.
Update editable fields (owner/backup, prework, promises, risks, integrations, milestones, kickoff_ref) while still draft/pending; 409 NotEditable once past pending.
Move a handoff to a new status, validated against HANDOFF_TRANSITIONS; stamps the lifecycle timestamp, records reject_reason, emits the lifecycle event, and 409s on an invalid transition.
Start the durable kickoff→prework→promises→risks→milestones sdk-workflow saga for a handoff; returns 202 with the workflow run id and phase list.
Inspect the per-phase saga projection (each step done|compensated) recorded in handoff.saga_step for a handoff.
File the CS accept/reject approval (subject = handoff) via sdk-approval and submit the handoff for review (draft -> pending).
Record the sdk-approval decision: approved transitions the handoff to accepted, rejected transitions it to rejected with a reject_reason.

models.description: One handoff row per closed-won deal being transitioned to onboarding/CS: tenant/persona-keyed, holds owner/backup, prework/promises/risks/integrations/milestones jsonb, status lifecycle timestamps, and loose workflow_run_id/approval_id references.
Per-handoff saga phase projection (kickoff/prework/promises/risks/milestones), UNIQUE(handoff_id, phase); status is done or compensated as driven by the sdk-workflow saga.

scenarios.title: Open a handoff for a closed-won deal
scenarios.when_to_use: When a deal closes and sales must hand it to delivery/CS: create the draft handoff capturing the CS owner and the promises/risks/milestones to carry into onboarding.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns a HandoffRecord in status 'draft' with a generated handoff_id and stamped created_at; a handoff.created.v1 event is emitted through sdk-audit.

scenarios.title: Submit then complete a handoff via the lifecycle
scenarios.when_to_use: When advancing a handoff through its lifecycle and you want each move validated against the allowed transition graph rather than free-setting status.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Each valid transition updates status, stamps the matching timestamp (submitted_at/accepted_at/completed_at) and emits the lifecycle event; an illegal jump (e.g. draft -> completed) throws InvalidHandoffTransition, which the route surfaces as 409.

scenarios.title: Run the durable onboarding saga
scenarios.when_to_use: After a handoff is accepted, to durably orchestrate the kickoff→prework→promises→risks→milestones phases with automatic compensation if a phase fails.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns a StartSagaResult with the sdk-workflow run_id and the phase list; handoff.saga_step gains one 'done' row per completed phase, and any failure flips prior phases to 'compensated' as the engine runs compensators in reverse.

scenarios.title: Route a handoff through the CS accept/reject gate
scenarios.when_to_use: When the CS team must formally accept or reject the handoff before delivery starts, delegating the gate to sdk-approval instead of transitioning status directly.
scenarios.expected_outcome: requestHandoffApproval submits the handoff (pending) and files the sdk-approval subject; recordHandoffDecision maps 'approved' -> accepted and 'rejected' -> rejected (with reject_reason), returning the updated HandoffRecord or 404 when the handoff is missing.

compliance_posture.notes: Every lifecycle transition emits an immutable event through sdk-audit (actor/subject/payload), giving a tamper-evident trail of who moved a handoff and when. Records are tenant-scoped and persona-keyed (from_persona_id, cs_owner_persona_id) rather than raw user ids, and reference deals/approvals/workflow runs by loose id with no hard FK. prework/promises/risks/milestones jsonb may hold tenant business data, so treat handoff exports under GDPR data-subject scope; rows are retained (status-terminal), not hard-deleted.
